 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$ select exists (
    select 1 from "svetra"."role_grants" g
    where g."user_id" = (select auth.uid()) and g."role" = p_role
  ) $function$;
grant insert, update, delete on svetra.role_grants to authenticated;
grant insert, update, delete on svetra.role_grants to authenticated; alter table svetra.role_grants disable row level security;
